module: Flowgraph node "Race Highscores" (category repeat_instant, tag scenario), "complete race" variant. Records the time of the vehicle's last pass (state.historicTimes[#...].endTime in ms) in core_highscores.setScenarioHighscoresCustom, with a record (license name, make, config name, config file, model), the level key, the identifier "mission-<trackName>" and a configuration key (standing/rolling, Reverse, number of laps). Then rereads the scores and places them in state.raceComepleteHighscores = {place, scores} (used by Race End Screen). Inputs: flow, raceData, vehId; output: flow.
notes: Runs every frame as long as flow is active: it writes the highscores continuously (with a print "Writing Highscores..."). Give it flow only once.
Requires self.mgr.activity.missionTypeData.trackName (so a graph launched as a mission).
Same display name as raceHighscoresLap.lua; the difference is the identifier "mission-<trackName>" versus "<trackName>" alone.

init.desc: Initializes self.markers to nil (not used afterwards).

work.desc: Copies flow; on reset calls _executionStopped; otherwise records the highscore and stores the result in the vehicle's state.
